statement: Source comparison: inspected Linux v7.2 hid-ids.h lacks STEAM_CONTROLLER_IBEX (28de:1302), whereas v7.3-rc1 hid-steam matches its HID_USB_DEVICE identity. Inferred for an unpatched pre-7.3 host, hid-steam will not claim 28de:1302, leaving generic HID/hidraw as potential attachment paths; SDL on an actual Linux 6.12 host is untested. Another driver, backport or actual kernel evdev report mapping: No evidence. v7.2 hid-ids.h 1373-1376; v7.3-rc1 hid-steam.c 2751-2755.

applicability.revision: Linux v7.2 versus v7.3-rc1; SDL pinned at 6defbc0; no physical revision measured
applicability.scope: Direct wired 28de:1302 source-consumer only; tests proposed in docs/steam-consumer-contention.md, not run
